full_judgment: 6. Mr. Md. Nazibar Rahman, learned Advocate for the defendant petitioners submits that the High Court Division erred in law in characterising the petitioners' possession of the suit property as trespassers and failed to decide the question of limitation in the context of the defendants' possession for a long period over 12 years before the institution of the suit.
